earned_premium.description: Written premium earned pro rata (daily) over each transaction's cover period. On an accident basis the denominator is the premium earned in the same period (standard pairing), so it equals calendar.

calendar.sql:
WITH grid AS (
  SELECT p_start::DATE AS period, (p_start + INTERVAL 1 YEAR)::DATE AS p_end
  FROM range(date_trunc('year', DATE '2019-01-01'), DATE '2025-12-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) t(p_start)
),
earned_premium AS (
  SELECT g.period, SUM(p.written_premium * GREATEST(date_diff('day', GREATEST(p.effective_date, g.period), LEAST(p.cover_end_date, g.p_end, DATE '2025-12-31' + 1)), 0) / date_diff('day', p.effective_date, p.cover_end_date)) AS value
  FROM grid g JOIN premium_txn p JOIN policy_term t ON t.term_id = p.term_id ON p.booked_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' AND p.effective_date < g.p_end AND p.cover_end_date > g.period AND g.period <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY ALL
),
keys AS (
  SELECT period FROM earned_premium
),
m AS (
  SELECT keys.*,
    earned_premium.value::DOUBLE AS earned_premium
  FROM keys
LEFT JOIN earned_premium USING (period)
)
SELECT
  CAST(year(m.period) AS VARCHAR) AS period,
  COALESCE(m.earned_premium, 0) AS earned_premium
FROM m
WHERE period <= DATE '2025-12-31'
ORDER BY period

ibnr.description: Bulk IBNR (incurred but not reported, including development on known claims), booked by the reserving team each quarter-end by accident year. Calendar basis: the change in total IBNR over the period. No policy-year basis and no segment dimensions.

calendar.sql:

  SELECT p_start::DATE AS period, (p_start + INTERVAL 1 YEAR)::DATE AS p_end
  FROM range(date_trunc('year', DATE '2019-01-01'), DATE '2025-12-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) t(p_start)
),
ibnr AS (
  SELECT g.period, COALESCE(e.total, 0) - COALESCE(b.total, 0) AS value
  FROM (SELECT period, LEAST(p_end - 1, DATE '2025-12-31') AS d_end, period - 1 AS d_begin FROM grid WHERE period <= DATE '2025-12-31') g
  ASOF LEFT JOIN (SELECT v.valuation_date AS vdate, SUM(v.ibnr) AS total FROM ibnr_valuation v GROUP BY 1) e ON g.d_end >= e.vdate

),
keys AS (
  SELECT period FROM ibnr
),
m AS (
  SELECT keys.*,
    ibnr.value::DOUBLE AS ibnr
  FROM keys
LEFT JOIN ibnr USING (period)
)
SELECT
  CAST(year(m.period) AS VARCHAR) AS period,
  COALESCE(m.ibnr, 0) AS ibnr
FROM m
WHERE period <= DATE '2025-12-31'
ORDER BY period

model_yaml:
# Insurance semantic layer — personal motor.
#
# A measure is defined *per time basis*. The same English word ("incurred loss") is a
# different computation on a calendar, accident or policy basis, and some measures have
# no meaning on some bases (premium has no accident date; IBNR is booked by accident
# year, not by policy year). A basis that isn't listed is an error, not a guess.
#
# Every computation is valued at `as_of`: only facts whose knowledge date is on or
# before it are used. Placeholders the compiler fills: {as_of}, {d} (snapshot date =
# min(period end − 1 day, as_of)), {p_start}, {p_end}.
#
# Measure kinds:
#   flow      sum (or distinct count) of rows whose basis date falls in the period
#   earned    pro-rata earning of [start, end) intervals, clipped to the period and to as_of
#   snapshot  balance at {d}; semi-additive: never summed across periods
#   valuation latest booked estimate at or before a date (ASOF join)

version: 0.1
name: personal_motor

sources:
  premium:
    from: premium_txn p JOIN policy_term t ON t.term_id = p.term_id
    knowledge_date: p.booked_date
    dimensions: &term_dims
      region: t.region
      channel: t.channel
      vehicle_group: t.vehicle_group
      driver_age_band: t.driver_age_band
      business_type: "CASE WHEN t.term_number = 1 THEN 'NEW' ELSE 'RENEWAL' END"
  claim_txn:
    from: claim_txn x JOIN claim c ON c.claim_id = x.claim_id JOIN policy_term t ON t.term_id = c.term_id
    knowledge_date: x.txn_date
    dimensions:
      <<: *term_dims
      peril: c.peril
  claim:
    from: claim c JOIN policy_term t ON t.term_id = c.term_id
    knowledge_date: c.report_date
    dimensions:
      <<: *term_dims
      peril: c.peril
  ibnr:
    from: ibnr_valuation v
    knowledge_date: v.valuation_date
    dimensions: {}            # booked in bulk by accident year; not allocated to segments
  expense:
    from: expense e
    knowledge_date: e.booked_date
    dimensions:
      channel: "COALESCE(e.channel, 'UNALLOCATED')"   # overheads are not allocated to channels
      expense_type: e.expense_type
  quote:
    from: quote q
    knowledge_date: q.quote_date
    dimensions:
      region: q.region
      channel: q.channel
      vehicle_group: q.vehicle_group
      driver_age_band: q.driver_age_band
  renewal:
    from: >-
      renewal_offer o JOIN policy_term t ON t.term_id = o.expiring_term_id
      LEFT JOIN policy_term rt ON rt.term_id = o.renewed_term_id
    knowledge_date: o.offer_date
    dimensions:
      <<: *term_dims

measures:
  written_premium:
    description: Premium booked (new, renewal, mid-term adjustments, cancellation returns). Gross of reinsurance.
    source: premium
    amount: p.written_premium
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: flow, date: p.booked_date}
      policy:   {kind: flow, date: t.inception_date}

  earned_premium:
    description: >-
      Written premium earned pro rata (daily) over each transaction's cover period. On an accident basis
      the denominator is the premium earned in the same period (standard pairing), so it equals calendar.
    source: premium
    amount: p.written_premium
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: earned, start: p.effective_date, end: p.cover_end_date}
      accident: {kind: earned, start: p.effective_date, end: p.cover_end_date}
      policy:   {kind: earned, start: p.effective_date, end: p.cover_end_date, cohort: t.inception_date}

  unearned_premium:
    description: Premium written but not yet earned, at the end of the period (or as_of). Semi-additive.
    source: premium
    amount: "p.written_premium * date_diff('day', GREATEST(p.effective_date, {d} + 1), p.cover_end_date) / date_diff('day', p.effective_date, p.cover_end_date)"
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: snapshot, where: "p.booked_date <= {d} AND p.cover_end_date > {d} + 1"}

  written_exposure:
    description: Car-years written (1 per new or renewal term; a cancellation returns the unexpired fraction).
    source: premium
    amount: p.exposure_units
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: flow, date: p.booked_date}
      policy:   {kind: flow, date: t.inception_date}

  earned_exposure:
    description: Car-years earned (exposure units earned pro rata over cover).
    source: premium
    amount: p.exposure_units
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: earned, start: p.effective_date, end: p.cover_end_date}
      accident: {kind: earned, start: p.effective_date, end: p.cover_end_date}
      policy:   {kind: earned, start: p.effective_date, end: p.cover_end_date, cohort: t.inception_date}

  in_force_count:
    description: Vehicles on cover at the end of the period (or as_of). Semi-additive.
    source: premium
    amount: p.vehicle_delta
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: snapshot, where: "p.booked_date <= {d} AND p.effective_date <= {d} AND p.cover_end_date > {d}"}

  paid_loss:
    description: Indemnity payments net of recoveries (salvage/subrogation). Excludes ALAE.
    source: claim_txn
    amount: x.amount
    where: "x.txn_type IN ('PAYMENT', 'RECOVERY') AND x.cost_type = 'INDEMNITY'"
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: flow, date: x.txn_date}
      accident: {kind: flow, date: c.accident_date}
      policy:   {kind: flow, date: t.inception_date}

  case_reserve:
    description: Outstanding case reserves set by claims handlers. Semi-additive on a calendar basis.
    source: claim_txn
    amount: x.amount
    where: "x.txn_type = 'RESERVE'"
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: snapshot, where: "x.txn_date <= {d}"}
      accident: {kind: flow, date: c.accident_date}
      policy:   {kind: flow, date: t.inception_date}

  reported_loss:
    description: >-
      Paid indemnity plus case reserves ("case incurred", Friedland's "reported"). Excludes IBNR and ALAE.
      On a calendar basis it is the change in reported loss during the period.
    source: claim_txn
    amount: x.amount
    where: "x.cost_type = 'INDEMNITY'"
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: flow, date: x.txn_date}
      accident: {kind: flow, date: c.accident_date}
      policy:   {kind: flow, date: t.inception_date}

  paid_alae:
    description: Allocated loss adjustment expense paid (legal and expert costs attributable to a claim).
    source: claim_txn
    amount: x.amount
    where: "x.cost_type = 'ALAE'"
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: flow, date: x.txn_date}
      accident: {kind: flow, date: c.accident_date}
      policy:   {kind: flow, date: t.inception_date}

  ibnr:
    description: >-
      Bulk IBNR (incurred but not reported, including development on known claims), booked by the
      reserving team each quarter-end by accident year. Calendar basis: the change in total IBNR over
      the period. No policy-year basis and no segment dimensions.
    source: ibnr
    amount: v.ibnr
    bases:
      accident: {kind: valuation, cohort_year: v.accident_year}
      calendar: {kind: valuation, change: true}

  reported_claim_count:
    description: Claims reported, including those later closed without payment.
    source: claim
    agg: count
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: flow, date: c.report_date}
      accident: {kind: flow, date: c.accident_date}
      policy:   {kind: flow, date: t.inception_date}

  paid_claim_count:
    description: Claims with at least one indemnity payment (excludes nil claims).
    source: claim_txn
    agg: count_distinct
    key: x.claim_id
    where: "x.txn_type = 'PAYMENT' AND x.cost_type = 'INDEMNITY'"
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: flow, date: x.txn_date}
      accident: {kind: flow, date: c.accident_date}
      policy:   {kind: flow, date: t.inception_date}

  open_claim_count:
    description: Claims reported and not closed at the end of the period (or as_of). Semi-additive.
    source: claim
    agg: count
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: snapshot, where: "c.report_date <= {d} AND (c.closed_date IS NULL OR c.closed_date > {d})"}

  expenses:
    description: Acquisition (comparison-site and direct), broker commission, and admin, by month incurred.
    source: expense
    amount: e.amount
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: flow, date: e.expense_month}

  quotes:
    description: Quotes issued, across all channels.
    source: quote
    agg: count
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: flow, date: q.quote_date}

  bound_quotes:
    description: Quotes that became a policy (new business only).
    source: quote
    agg: count
    where: q.bound_term_id IS NOT NULL
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: flow, date: q.quote_date}

  renewals_due:
    description: >-
      Renewal invitations whose expiry date has passed by as_of (matured). Invitations still pending at
      as_of are excluded, otherwise retention is understated for recent periods.
    source: renewal
    agg: count
    where: "o.due_date <= {as_of}"
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: flow, date: o.due_date}

  renewals_accepted:
    description: Matured renewal invitations that were accepted (the renewed term was bound by as_of).
    source: renewal
    agg: count
    where: "o.due_date <= {as_of} AND rt.bound_date <= {as_of}"
    bases:
      calendar: {kind: flow, date: o.due_date}

metrics:
  # Ratios are always ratios of sums at the requested grain; they are never averaged.
  loss_ratio_paid:
    description: Paid indemnity / earned premium.
    expr: paid_loss / earned_premium
  loss_ratio_reported:
    description: (Paid + case reserves) / earned premium. Excludes IBNR and ALAE.
    expr: reported_loss / earned_premium
  loss_ratio_ultimate:
    description: (Reported loss + IBNR) / earned premium. Accident or calendar basis only.
    expr: (reported_loss + ibnr) / earned_premium
  loss_alae_ratio_ultimate:
    description: (Reported loss + IBNR + paid ALAE) / earned premium.
    expr: (reported_loss + ibnr + paid_alae) / earned_premium
  expense_ratio:
    description: Expenses / earned premium (statutory-style; the trade basis divides by written).
    expr: expenses / earned_premium
  expense_ratio_written:
    description: Expenses / written premium (trade basis).
    expr: expenses / written_premium
  combined_ratio:
    description: (Reported loss + IBNR + paid ALAE + expenses) / earned premium. Calendar basis.
    expr: (reported_loss + ibnr + paid_alae + expenses) / earned_premium
  claim_frequency:
    description: Reported claims per earned car-year.
    expr: reported_claim_count / earned_exposure
  severity_reported:
    description: Reported loss per reported claim (nil claims in the denominator).
    expr: reported_loss / reported_claim_count
  severity_paid:
    description: Paid loss per paid claim (nil claims excluded).
    expr: paid_loss / paid_claim_count
  pure_premium:
    description: Reported loss per earned car-year.
    expr: reported_loss / earned_exposure
  average_written_premium:
    description: Written premium per written car-year.
    expr: written_premium / written_exposure
  retention_rate:
    description: Accepted / matured renewal invitations (policy-count basis).
    expr: renewals_accepted / renewals_due
  quote_conversion:
    description: Bound / issued quotes.
    expr: bound_quotes / quotes
